scientific_limitations: Classical root-pairing determinant equation and genus-two equivalence are prior results, not new findings.
Normal crossing is proved at a rational witness and on a dense open subset of the stated family only.
No classification of all singularities, no assertion about the coarse moduli quotient or positive characteristic.
Historical priority of the local singularity assertion remains best of knowledge.
scientific_scope: Reduced bielliptic divisor in the smooth squarefree binary-sextic coefficient space over the complex numbers; generic normal crossing along the family {±1, ±a, ±a^{-1}}.
title: Generic ordinary crossing of the bielliptic binary-sextic divisor at the two-involution locus
